origin.description: Every sample moment from order 0 up to a chosen order.
origin.usage: all.moments(x, order.max = 2, central = FALSE, absolute = FALSE, na.rm = FALSE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A numeric vector, matrix, or data frame.

arguments.name: order.max
arguments.text: The highest order. It must be at least 2. A fraction is truncated toward zero. In Python the argument is order_max.

arguments.name: central
arguments.text: Subtract the mean before each power.

arguments.name: absolute
arguments.text: Take the absolute value after centering.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: Drop missing values inside each column. In Python the argument is na_rm.

origin.details: The first entry is the order-0 moment, which is 1. The next is the mean when the moments are raw. A data frame is returned as a matrix, and that matrix does not keep the column names.
origin.value: A vector for a vector, or a matrix with one row per order and one column per variable.
